champions.name: Hecarim
champions.title: the Shadow of War

passive.name: Warpath
passive.desc: Bonus AD from bonus MS.

Q.name: Rampage
Q.desc: AoE slam. Stacks reduce CD (min ~1s at 3 stacks).

W.name: Spirit of Dread
W.desc: AoE zone dealing magic per second. Heals from all nearby damage.

E.name: Devastating Charge
E.desc: Charge: increasing MS → empowered AA knockback + damage scaling distance.

R.name: Onslaught of Shadows
R.desc: Dash forward with spectral riders. AoE fear on arrival.

champions.playstyle: Dive jungler. E charge into R teamfight fear. W sustain in fights.

champions.name: Heimerdinger
champions.title: the Revered Inventor

passive.name: Hextech Affinity
passive.desc: Gain MS near allied turrets and own turrets.

Q.name: H-28G Evolution Turret
Q.desc: Place up to 3 turrets that auto-attack enemies.

W.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
W.desc: Fire 5 converging rockets dealing magic damage.

E.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
E.desc: AoE stun grenade (center stun, outer slow).

R.name: UPGRADE!!!
R.desc: Empower next Q/W/E. Q = mega turret, W = rocket barrage, E = mega stun.

champions.playstyle: Zone control mage. Turrets control lane. R+Q mega turret for fights.

champions.name: Irelia
champions.title: the Blade Dancer

passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.desc: Stacking AS on ability/AA hits. At max stacks, AAs deal bonus magic.

Q.name: Bladesurge
Q.desc: Dash to target. Kills/marked targets reset CD. Heals on hit.

W.name: Defiant Dance
W.desc: Charge: damage reduction + channel. Release: AoE physical damage.

E.name: Flawless Duet
E.desc: Place 2 blades → they fly together, stunning + marking enemies between.

R.name: Vanguard's Edge
R.desc: Throw blades in cage around target area. Champions hit are marked + damaged.

champions.playstyle: Mobile duelist. Q reset chains through minions. E stun setup. R for teamfight marks.

champions.name: Janna
champions.title: the Storm's Fury

passive.name: Tailwind
passive.desc: Allies moving toward Janna gain bonus MS.

Q.name: Howling Gale
Q.desc: Charge tornado. Longer charge = more range + damage + knockup duration.

W.name: Zephyr
W.desc: Passive: bonus MS + ghosting. Active: target slow + magic damage. Lose passive during CD.

E.name: Eye of the Storm
E.desc: Shield ally/turret + bonus AD while shield holds.

R.name: Monsoon
R.desc: AoE heal channel + knockback all enemies away from you.

champions.playstyle: Peel enchanter. E shield + AD for carry. R disengage/heal in teamfights.

champions.name: Jarvan IV
champions.title: the Exemplar of Demacia

passive.name: Martial Cadence
passive.desc: First AA per target deals %current HP bonus physical. CD per target.

Q.name: Dragon Strike
Q.desc: Thrust lance dealing physical + shred armor. Combos with E for dash.

W.name: Golden Aegis
W.desc: Shield (scales with nearby enemies) + AoE slow.

E.name: Demacian Standard
E.desc: Place flag (grants AS aura). Q toward flag = dash + knockup.

R.name: Cataclysm
R.desc: Leap to target creating impassable terrain ring. Damages enemies inside.

champions.playstyle: Jungle diver. E+Q combo for knockup engage. R traps key targets.

champions.name: Jax
champions.title: Grandmaster at Arms

passive.name: Relentless Assault
passive.desc: AAs grant stacking AS (up to 8 stacks).

Q.name: Leap Strike
Q.desc: Dash to target (ally or enemy). Deals physical damage to enemies.

W.name: Empower
W.desc: Next AA deals bonus magic damage. AA reset.

E.name: Counter Strike
E.desc: Dodge all AAs for 2s. Recast: AoE stun + damage (more per dodge).

R.name: Grandmaster's Might
R.desc: Passive: every 3rd AA deals bonus magic. Active: gain armor + MR for 8s.

champions.playstyle: Late-game duelist. E dodge for outplays. R gives tankiness + 3-hit passive.

champions.name: Jayce
champions.title: the Defender of Tomorrow

passive.name: Hextech Capacitor
passive.desc: Gain MS when switching forms.

Q.name: Shock Blast / To The Skies!
Q.desc: Ranged: skillshot. Melee: leap + AoE slam.

W.name: Hyper Charge / Lightning Field
W.desc: Ranged: 3 fast AAs. Melee: AoE magic damage.

E.name: Acceleration Gate / Thundering Blow
E.desc: Ranged: deploy speed gate (empowers Q). Melee: knockback + %HP.

R.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
R.desc: Switch Ranged/Melee form at level 1. No ult level-up needed.

champions.playstyle: Form-swap poke/bruiser. Ranged E+Q for poke. Melee for all-in burst.

champions.name: Jhin
champions.title: the Virtuoso

passive.name: Whisper
passive.desc: 4-shot AA. 4th shot always crits + bonus %HP damage. Fixed AS; AD/crit/AS → bonus AD.

Q.name: Dancing Grenade
Q.desc: Bouncing grenade (4 targets). More damage per kill in chain.

W.name: Deadly Flourish
W.desc: Long-range skillshot. Roots recently-damaged/movement-impaired champions.

E.name: Captive Audience
E.desc: Place invisible trap. Triggered: slow → AoE damage. Also placed on kills.

R.name: Curtain Call
R.desc: Channel: 4 long-range shots. Each damages in a line. 4th shot deals massive bonus damage.

champions.playstyle: Utility ADC. Fixed 4-shot with massive 4th shot crit. R for long-range picks.

champions.name: Jinx
champions.title: the Loose Cannon

passive.name: Get Excited!
passive.desc: On kill/assist, gain huge MS + AS boost.

Q.name: Switcheroo!
Q.desc: Toggle: Pow-Pow (minigun, stacking AS) / Fishbones (rocket, AoE + range + mana).

W.name: Zap!
W.desc: Long-range skillshot dealing physical + slow.

E.name: Flame Chompers!
E.desc: Place 3 traps in line. Root enemies that step on them.

R.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
R.desc: Global rocket. Damage scales with target's missing HP. AoE splash.

champions.playstyle: Hypercarry ADC. Get Excited passive enables resets in teamfights. Global R execute.

champions.name: K'Sante
champions.title: the Pride of Nazumah

passive.name: Dauntless Instinct
passive.desc: 3rd ability/AA deals bonus %max HP damage. Switches damage type.

Q.name: Ntofo Strikes
Q.desc: Slam → skillshot on 3rd cast. Slow on hit.

W.name: Path Maker
W.desc: Charge: damage reduction + unstoppable. Release: dash + stun.

E.name: Footwork
E.desc: Dash. If hits champion, dash again.

R.name: All Out
R.desc: Grab enemy, dash through wall. Transform: trade defenses for AD + omnivamp. Abilities change.

champions.playstyle: Technical tank. Tanky in base form; R transforms into squishy damage dealer. High skill ceiling.

champions.name: Kai'Sa
champions.title: Daughter of the Void

passive.name: Second Skin
passive.desc: AA stacks plasma. At 5 stacks = burst magic damage (scaling AP + %HP). Abilities evolve with stats.

Q.name: Icathian Rain
Q.desc: Fire 6 missiles at nearby enemies. Extra damage to isolated.

W.name: Void Seeker
W.desc: Long-range skillshot. Applies 2 plasma stacks. Reveals.

E.name: Supercharger
E.desc: Gain MS + AS burst. Become invisible briefly during.

R.name: Killer Instinct
R.desc: Dash with shield to location near enemy with plasma stacks.

champions.playstyle: Hybrid ADC. Evolve abilities through items. R dash for assassination or repositioning.

champions.name: Kalista
champions.title: the Spear of Vengeance

passive.name: Martial Poise
passive.desc: AAs and Q cause Kalista to dash (cannot cancel). Oathsworn ally bond.

Q.name: Pierce
Q.desc: Skillshot that carries rend stacks through killed targets.

W.name: Sentinel
W.desc: Passive: oathsworn nearby → bonus magic on same target. Active: send soul to scout.

E.name: Rend
E.desc: Pull out all spears lodged in enemies, dealing massive damage scaling with stacks.

R.name: Fate's Call
R.desc: Pull oathsworn ally to you → they can relaunch for knockup.

champions.playstyle: Kiting ADC. Constant dashing AAs. E rend for burst. R to save/engage with support.

champions.name: Karma
champions.title: the Enlightened One

passive.name: Gathering Fire
passive.desc: AA and abilities on champions reduce R cooldown.

Q.name: Inner Flame
Q.desc: Skillshot AoE explosion on hit.

W.name: Focused Resolve
W.desc: Tether to target. If maintained, root + damage.

E.name: Inspire
E.desc: Shield ally + MS boost.

R.name: Mantra
R.desc: Empower next Q/W/E. Q = larger AoE + DoT zone. W = bonus heal. E = AoE shield + MS to all nearby allies.

champions.playstyle: Flex enchanter. R+E AoE shield/MS. R+Q for poke. R available at level 1.

champions.name: Kassadin
champions.title: the Void Walker

passive.name: Void Stone
passive.desc: Reduced magic damage taken. AAs deal bonus magic + restore mana.

Q.name: Null Sphere
Q.desc: Targeted magic damage + silence/interrupt.

W.name: Nether Blade
W.desc: Passive: AAs deal bonus magic. Active: empower next AA for more + mana restore.

E.name: Force Pulse
E.desc: Cone AoE + slow. Requires 6 nearby ability casts to charge.

R.name: Riftwalk
R.desc: Blink dealing AoE magic. Stacks: more damage + more mana cost per stack. Resets 15s.

champions.playstyle: Scaling assassin. Weak early; godlike after level 13. R blink = infinite mobility.

champions.name: Katarina
champions.title: the Sinister Blade

passive.name: Voracity
passive.desc: Champion kills/assists reset all basic ability CDs. Picking up daggers deals AoE magic.

Q.name: Bouncing Blades
Q.desc: Throw dagger (bounces). Lands behind first target.

W.name: Preparation
W.desc: Place dagger at feet + gain MS.

E.name: Shunpo
E.desc: Blink to target (ally/enemy/dagger). Picking up nearby dagger = AoE.

R.name: Death Lotus
R.desc: Channel: throw daggers at 3 nearest champs dealing massive magic + applying GW.

champions.playstyle: Reset assassin. E to daggers for AoE. Get kill → all CDs reset → chain kills.

champions.name: Kayle
champions.title: the Righteous

passive.name: Divine Ascent
passive.desc: Level 1: melee. Level 5: ranged. Level 10: waves. Level 15: permanent fire AoE.

Q.name: Radiant Blast
Q.desc: Skillshot slow + shred armor/MR.

W.name: Celestial Blessing
W.desc: Heal self/ally + MS.

E.name: Starfire Spellblade
E.desc: Passive: AAs deal bonus magic. Active: empower next AA for execute.

R.name: Divine Judgment
R.desc: Make ally invulnerable for 2.5s + AoE swords damage around target.

champions.playstyle: Scaling hypercarry. Weak early (melee). Level 5 = ranged. Level 15 = godlike AoE.

champions.name: Kayn
champions.title: the Shadow Reaper

passive.name: The Darkin Scythe
passive.desc: Orbs from combat transform Kayn → Shadow Assassin (ranged hits) or Rhaast/Darkin (melee hits).

Q.name: Reaping Slash
Q.desc: Dash + circle slash. Rhaast: %max HP. SA: bonus damage.

W.name: Blade's Reach
W.desc: Line slash dealing physical. Rhaast: knockup. SA: longer range + slow.

E.name: Shadow Step
E.desc: Walk through walls (stealth + MS + heal). SA: longer duration.

R.name: Umbral Trespass
R.desc: Enter enemy body → emerge dealing damage. Rhaast: %max HP heal. SA: bonus burst.

champions.playstyle: Form-evolving jungler. SA: squishy assassin. Rhaast: drain-tank bruiser. E wall-walk for ganks.

champions.name: Kennen
champions.title: the Heart of the Tempest

passive.name: Mark of the Storm
passive.desc: Abilities apply marks. At 3 marks: stun target.

Q.name: Thundering Shuriken
Q.desc: Skillshot dealing magic damage + applying mark.

W.name: Electrical Surge
W.desc: Passive: every 5th AA applies mark. Active: damage all marked nearby enemies.

E.name: Lightning Rush
E.desc: Transform into lightning ball: MS + ghosting + AoE damage + mark. Can't AA during.

R.name: Slicing Maelstrom
R.desc: AoE storm around Kennen dealing magic damage + applying marks to nearby enemies.

champions.playstyle: Teamfight engage mage. Flash+R into enemy team for multi-stun AoE.

champions.name: Kha'Zix
champions.title: the Voidreaver

passive.name: Unseen Threat
passive.desc: When unseen, next AA deals bonus magic + slow.

Q.name: Taste Their Fear
Q.desc: Slash target. ISOLATED targets take massive bonus damage.

W.name: Void Spike
W.desc: Fire spike dealing physical + heal if hit at close range.

E.name: Leap
E.desc: Jump to location dealing AoE physical on landing.

R.name: Void Assault
R.desc: 2 casts of stealth (1s each) + MS. Passive: evolve 1 ability per ult rank.

champions.playstyle: Isolation assassin. Q deals massive single-target damage to isolated. R stealth resets passive.

champions.name: Kog'Maw
champions.title: the Mouth of the Abyss

passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.desc: On death, become a bomb. Explode after 4s dealing true damage.

Q.name: Caustic Spittle
Q.desc: Skillshot dealing magic + shredding armor/MR. Passive: bonus AS.

W.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
W.desc: Activate: AAs gain bonus range + deal %max HP magic on-hit.

E.name: Void Ooze
E.desc: AoE line slow + magic damage.

R.name: Living Artillery
R.desc: Long-range AoE poke. Stacking mana cost. Bonus damage to low HP.

champions.playstyle: Hyperscaling ADC. W gives massive range + %HP on-hit. Needs peel to survive.
